 Weather: Tracking rain later this week in the Baltimore metro area
 By WBAL-TV 11 
 November 3, 2026 
 Maryland will enjoy another mild day on Wednesday before much-needed rain arrives later this week.
 SCHOOL CLOSINGS AND DELAYS  |  WEATHER MAP  |  TRAFFIC  |  HOURLY FORECAST 
 Patchy fog is possible early on Wednesday morning, otherwise skies will turn mostly sunny again.
 Wednesday will turn out warm with highs in the mid-70s.
